list: The official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden.
note: Names, descriptions, grades and hidden flags are the official list as published on PlayStation and listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Every guide below is original writing for this atlas, with its sources named beside it.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. It unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned; nothing about it can be locked out.
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours, so there is no separate task to do for it. Plan around the long pole instead: the story (five chapters, roughly 60-80 hours), the 100% completion checklist behind the gold 'A Long Road', and the one possibly missable meditation for 'Positive Mental Attitude' in Chapter 1. PowerPyx rates the platinum 4/10 for difficulty and about 200 hours in total, with no online trophies and no difficulty settings to worry about.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. It is the opening mission and cannot be skipped past.
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end. It is the first mission of the game, so this trophy is simply the reward for starting the story and seeing its first job through.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Chapters complete in order as the story is played.
trophies.guide: Finish every main mission in Chapter 1. Before you leave the chapter, do the one thing the roadmap warns about: after the mission Down to Earth, look for Lucia at Jason's house in the morning, follow her to the balcony when she talks about meditating, and accept — that single meditation is the only interaction in the game currently flagged as possibly missable, and it feeds the 'Positive Mental Attitude' trophy.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Chapters complete in order as the story is played.
trophies.guide: Finish every main mission in Chapter 2. Keep the save habit the roadmap recommends: hold a manual save at the start and at the end of each chapter, since missions cannot be replayed and the game offers 15 manual save slots plus one autosave.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Chapters complete in order as the story is played.
trophies.guide: Finish every main mission in Chapter 3. By now the side characters with their own finale trophies (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are part of the world — take their missions when they appear, because every trophy-related quest giver stays available again in free roam after the story, so none of them can lock you out.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Chapters complete in order as the story is played.
trophies.guide: Finish every main mission in Chapter 4. This is the last chapter before the finale, so it is a good moment to check the in-game Progress menu (Touch Pad, then Progress) and see which counters — stunts, races, WAiNK scans, meditation spots — have already been building up while you played.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. The final mission is the end of the story and always available at the end of Chapter 4.
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. Once it is done the game returns you to free roam, and that is when the real clean-up begins: the 100% Completion Checklist unlocks under Progress, showing everything still outstanding, and every trophy-related character and activity remains reachable.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Story missions stay available until completed; there is no mission replay, but nothing here can be skipped past.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Like every named-mission trophy, it unlocks naturally while playing through the story — just follow the mission marker and finish the job.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Story missions stay available until completed.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is one of the big set-piece heists of the campaign, so expect a longer mission with a planned approach and a getaway — finish it and the trophy pops.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Story missions stay available until completed.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Another mission trophy that comes from simply playing the story through — no side requirement, no special condition.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Story missions stay available until completed.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Play the mission through to its conclusion; the trophy is tied to the mission itself, not to any optional objective inside it.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Story missions stay available until completed.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. The name gives the setting away — the job takes place at the airport — and finishing it is all the trophy asks.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Story missions stay available until completed.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a late-story operation, so come into it with the story's later gear and vehicles at your disposal, and finish the operation to earn the trophy.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. The checklist stays open in free roam after the story, and progress made during the story already counts toward it.
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist only becomes visible after the story, under Progress, but everything you did during the campaign already counts toward it — so do not wait to start scanning vehicles, trying activities and picking up collectibles. PowerPyx names this the hardest trophy in the game and the bulk of the roughly 200-hour platinum: the checklist asks for, among other things, 15 complete collectible card sets out of 18, 100 WAiNK locations, dozens of robberies (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vault robberies) and 100 optional tasks. Work through the checklist line by line after the finale instead of guessing.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Stunts can be attempted anywhere in free roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. A stunt is any scored airtime, near-miss, drift, wheelie or jump the game registers while driving or riding — the counter builds up naturally across a long playthrough, and there are 397 stunts in the game in total, so you need a little over half of them. Chase the counter deliberately in free roam: fast bikes, ramps and long jumps rack it up fastest, and the in-game Progress menu shows how far along you are.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. All 52 areas stay explorable in free roam.
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel, and this trophy needs every named area visited at least once. Drive the whole state deliberately: the cities, the swamps, the keys, the small towns and the back roads — use the map's area names to spot the gaps, and finish the last few with a road trip after the story.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Gang operations stay available in free roam; the checklist wants 39 of them, so there are plenty to choose from.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs its own operations around Leonida — hit one operation per gang, nine gangs in total. The 100% checklist wants 39 gang operations overall, so this trophy is a milestone on the way: vary your targets rather than hitting the same gang's spots twice, and the trophy pops when the ninth gang's operation is robbed.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Ocean Beach bars stay open in free roam.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take it in with the ocean in front of you — the trophy is a quiet moment, not a mission. Any beachfront bar will do; sit, drink, and let the view do the work.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Vehicle showrooms stay open in free roam.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car into a showroom, then floor it straight back out through the glass — the 'classic style' is the old-school drive-through-the-window exit. Pick a showroom with a big glass front, build speed inside, and crash out through the window for the trophy.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Mobalytics — GTA 6 Trophy List & Walkthrough

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. The bowling alley stays open in free roam.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go bowling there and play a frame — the follow-through is the bowling itself, so finish a game at that alley and the trophy pops. Bring your partner along if you like; the alley is one of Leonida's leisure spots and stays open after the story.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Partnership moments can be earned in free roam with your partner.
trophies.guide: Build a partnership with mass appeal — a shared moment with your partner that the whole of Leonida notices. Play the partner activities together and look for the big, public, crowd-pleasing ones: the trophy is about the two of you doing something memorable in front of an audience, not about a single mission.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Choices keep appearing across the story and free roam.
trophies.guide: Make choices — for better or worse. Leonida is full of small decisions, from dialogue options to the way you handle a job, and the game keeps a count of the choices you make. Play naturally, take the decisions the game offers instead of avoiding them, and the trophy pops once the count is reached.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. It is a retry moment that can happen anywhere in the game.
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This trophy is about the retry: fail something, then succeed on the second attempt. If a mission, challenge or activity goes wrong the first time, go straight back in and finish it on the next try — the trophy rewards the comeback, not the first attempt.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Mobalytics — GTA 6 Trophy List & Walkthrough

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Strange encounters stay in the world in free roam.
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the 'what the hell just happened?' moment. Leonida hides odd encounters and unexplained sights off the beaten track, especially at night and in the remoter corners of the map. Explore the strange places, follow the weird lights and sounds, and the trophy pops when you stumble into one of the game's unexplained events.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Melee drive-bys can be done any time in free roam.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. A melee drive-by means striking someone with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle — drive slowly past a pedestrian, swing as you pass, and knock them down like a bowling pin. Find a quiet street, line the pass up carefully, and the trophy pops on a clean hit.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Mobalytics — GTA 6 Trophy List & Walkthrough

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Marked bills keep coming from robberies in free roam, and contacts keep laundering them.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Robberies pay out in marked bills that cannot be spent directly — take them to your contacts to launder them into clean cash, and the trophy tracks the laundered total. Rob banks, vaults and trucks to keep the bills flowing, launder regularly instead of hoarding, and the $250,000 total arrives as a side effect of the robbery trophies.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Shops stay open in free roam and spending is cumulative.
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative and counts every shop in Leonida — clothes, weapons, food, car mods, anything with a price tag. Spend as you play rather than saving it for the end: buy the gear you actually want, upgrade your cars, and the $100,000 will be gone long before you notice. It pairs naturally with the money earned from robberies and laundering.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Garage properties can be bought any time in free roam once you have the money.
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought through the property listings around Leonida — each one gives you somewhere to store vehicles, and the trophy needs all eight owned. Save up through the story's robberies and the laundering trophy, then buy them one by one; the most expensive ones are best left until the late game, when money flows freely.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. The Scooter Bros app works in free roam with any discovered vehicle.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find a vehicle you have discovered, open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone, and register it — repeat with nine more different vehicles. It pairs with the 'Whip It Good' discovery trophy: every new vehicle you find is another candidate to register, so do both together while exploring.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Every activity type stays available in free roam.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The nine are the game's side pastimes — racing, fishing, shooting range, drone racing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the rest of the Leonida leisure list — and one taste of each is enough. Work through them early in the story so the trophy pops while you are still exploring, and use the activity icons on the map to find each type.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Shooting ranges stay open in free roam and challenges can be retried.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each range offers timed target drills with bronze, silver and gold score bands, and you can retry any challenge as often as you like. Learn the scoring first — headshots and fast, accurate strings beat spraying — then work range by range; the gold band is the only one that counts, so a silver on a challenge means going back for it.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Drone race locations stay open in free roam.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location hosts its own race course; a win at a location checks it off, and the trophy needs a win at every one. Fly the racing line rather than the scenery — cut corners through gates, keep speed through the turns, and retry a course immediately if you clip a gate, since only the win counts.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Races stay available in free roam.
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Only distinct races count, so winning the same race twice adds nothing — spread out across Leonida's race map instead. Pick a fast, stable car for each race type, learn the first corner (most races are won or lost there), and tick races off one at a time until the counter hits 20.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Fishing challenges stay available in free roam.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing in Leonida is a timed contest of technique, not luck: keep tension on the line without snapping it, reel steadily when the fish runs toward you, and watch Cal's score as the benchmark to beat. Challenge him at a fishing spot, out-fish him, and the trophy is yours.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Arcades stay open in free roam.
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet in Leonida, start a game, and play it to its end — finishing is what counts, not a high score. Any cabinet, any game; pick the shortest one and see it through.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Andy's quest line stays available and he returns after the story; quest givers may be briefly unavailable mid-story but always come back.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's quest line. Andy's missions are Lucia-only, so play them as Lucia whenever his icon is up. Work through his strand from its first job to its last; the trophy pops on the finale. If his icon vanishes for a stretch of the story, do not worry — PowerPyx notes all trophy-related quest givers become available again later.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Kenton may be temporarily unavailable during parts of the story, but he returns and his line stays completable in free roam.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's quest line. Kenton is one of the characters who goes quiet for stretches of the story — the roadmap is explicit that this is temporary and every trophy-related quest giver is there again after the story. Take his missions whenever his icon appears and finish the strand to its last job.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTASpotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Billy's quest line stays completable in free roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's quest line. Follow Billy's strand from its first job to its last; the trophy is the reward for seeing his whole story through, and like the other character finales it can be finished in free roam after the main story ends.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Stranger strands are not on the 100% checklist, but they stay available in free roam; the count is 8 strands, and there are more than 8 strangers in the game.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers appear as their own icons on the map — each one is a short chain of jobs, and a finished chain counts as one strand. There are more strangers than the eight the trophy needs, so pick the shortest chains first and finish eight of them; note that these strands are not part of the 100% completion checklist, so they are easy to leave until the clean-up stage.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Randy's quest line stays completable in free roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's quest line. Work through Randy's jobs in order until the strand ends; the trophy pops on the finale, and the whole line can be wrapped up after the story in free roam if you have not finished it by then.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Tyrone's quest line stays completable in free roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's quest line. Tyrone's missions are Jason-only, so play them as Jason when his icon is up. Finish the strand to its last job for the trophy.

sources.name: GTASpotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableWhy: POTENTIALLY MISSABLE — the only trophy flagged as such. One meditation, at Jason's house in Chapter 1 after the mission Down to Earth, disappears when Chapter 1 ends. PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed whether that meditation is actually required, because it raises the counter but is not marked as a normal meditation spot.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in total. Do the Chapter 1 one FIRST, before anything else can go wrong: after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning; she says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony — follow her, accept the prompt, and let her teach you. That balcony meditation is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and it is the only trophy-related interaction in the game flagged as potentially missable. The other 17 spots are ordinary meditation locations across Leonida, found through the map and usable in free roam; meditate at each one and the trophy pops. If you already passed Chapter 1 without the balcony meditation, keep a chapter-start save to reload — and note the honest caveat from PowerPyx: it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy actually requires that one meditation.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.chapter: Chapter 1 — after Down to Earth (Jason's house balcony)
trophies.mission: Down to Earth, then Lucia's balcony meditation

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Bret's hunt stays available in free roam; Bret's line is Jason-only.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand is Jason-only, so take it on as Jason. The hunt is a tracking job: follow the animal's signs to its territory, move quietly, and take the shot cleanly — the trophy is for the unique animal Bret asks for, not for ordinary hunting.

sources.name: GTASpotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Cards stay in the world in free roam and can be collected after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card sets scattered across Leonida, and the 100% checklist wants 15 of them — but this trophy needs only 3 full sets. Start with the sets nearest the early story areas, learn the card glow and the way cards hide in shops, houses and landmarks, and finish three sets to pop the trophy on the way to the bigger checklist goal.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. WAiNK scanning works anywhere in free roam.
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game app for scanning unfamiliar vehicles and locations — open it, point it at something new, and the scan counts. Build the habit during the story: scan every new vehicle and every new place you pass, and the counter climbs without a dedicated grind. The checklist also wants 100 WAiNK locations, so this trophy and the 100% goal are the same work.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Challenges stay open in free roam; the game tracks 80 of them and only 50 are needed here.
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. The game tracks 80 challenges in total — small feats across driving, combat, exploration and side activities — and this trophy needs 50 of them, while the 100% checklist wants 70. Pick the easy ones first (they overlap heavily with the other trophies: stunts, races, scans, robberies), check the Progress menu to see which are already done, and mop up the cheapest remaining ones in free roam.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTASpotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Wanted levels and partner play are available in free roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape the heat. Build the wanted level deliberately — cause enough trouble to reach four stars with your partner riding along — then break line of sight, get out of the search area, and stay hidden until the stars clear. A fast car, a quiet back road and no fresh crimes while hiding are the whole method.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Shop robberies with a partner can be done in free roam.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. The trick is the 'without losing' part: the wanted level must stay alive across all three robberies, so do not let the stars clear between shops. Plan a route of three close shops, hit them one after another with your partner, keep moving, and do not stop to fight the police until the third till is empty.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Vehicles keep appearing in free roam; discovery is permanent.
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A vehicle counts as discovered when you first get close to a new model — so drive everywhere and look at everything. The WAiNK app helps here too: scanning unfamiliar vehicles is the same habit that feeds the 'You WAiNKer!' trophy. Cruise the different districts, since rare models cluster in particular neighbourhoods, and the counter will pass 100 well before you run out of Leonida to explore.

PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Combat Focus can be used in any fight in free roam.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the game's slow-down aiming mode — trigger it when a group of enemies is bunched together, then drop five of them before the meter runs out. Pick a fight with plenty of enemies in the open (a gang shootout or a wanted-level stand-off), wait until they cluster, and make every shot count while time is slowed.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. VCIA stays accessible in free roam.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — Vice City International Airport. In plain terms: steal a plane at the airport and take off without a flight plan. Get onto the airfield, find a plane on the tarmac, get in and get airborne before security stops you; the trophy pops when you leave the airport by air on your own schedule.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Rhino tanks appear in free roam at high wanted levels and at military sites.
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhino tanks — the trophy's own description, 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos', is the hint. Rhinos roll out when the heat is at its highest, so push your wanted level up in free roam until the tanks arrive, then survive the encounter: use cover, sticky bombs or a fast vehicle to stay alive around them, and the trophy pops for tangling with the tanks.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Jewelry stores can be robbed again in free roam.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. This is a stealth job, not a smash-and-grab: case the store first, move when the clerk and the cameras are looking away, keep your weapon holstered until the moment matters, and get in and out before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again — detection is what fails it, so patience beats speed.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Bank vault robberies stay available in free roam; the checklist wants 8 vault robberies, more than this trophy's 5.
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Each vault job is a planned robbery: get in, crack the vault, grab the cash and get out alive — the escape is part of the trophy, so a vault cracked with no getaway does not count. Five successful vault jobs earn the silver; the 100% checklist wants eight, so keep going past five if you are chasing the gold 'A Long Road' too.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.missableWhy: Not missable. Armored trucks roam Leonida in free roam.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida — spot one, force it to stop (a block or a well-placed ram works), crack it open, take the cash and lose the heat. The escape is part of the trophy, so have a getaway car ready before you start the job, not after.
